name: mc3000-mcp
description: Safe MCP server for SKYRC MC3000-compatible battery chargers over Bluetooth Low Energy.

tools.name: mc3000_scan
tools.description: Scan BLE devices and return devices whose advertised name matches the official MC3000 app filters.

tools.name: mc3000_connect
tools.description: Connect to MC3000 by BLE address, or scan and connect to the first matching charger if address is omitted.

tools.name: mc3000_disconnect
tools.description: Disconnect from charger.

tools.name: mc3000_status
tools.description: Poll slot status. Slot is zero-based 0..3; omit slot to poll all four.

tools.name: mc3000_start
tools.description: Start charging/program on a zero-based slot 0..3.

tools.name: mc3000_stop
tools.description: Stop a zero-based slot 0..3.

tools.name: mc3000_get_version
tools.description: Read firmware/hardware version.

tools.name: mc3000_get_basic
tools.description: Read basic device settings.

tools.name: mc3000_set_basic
tools.description: Set basic device settings.

tools.name: mc3000_get_voltage_curve
tools.description: Read voltage curve for a zero-based slot. Response is parsed into millivolt points.

tools.name: mc3000_mc5000_status
tools.description: Read slot status using MC5000 frame layout (opcode 0x91).

tools.name: mc3000_build_profile
tools.description: Build a 40-byte MC3000 profile/program frame without sending it.

tools.name: mc3000_apply_profile
tools.description: Apply a profile/program. Pass profile_hex from mc3000_build_profile or pass the same profile fields directly. Optionally start selected slots.

tools.name: mc3000_send_raw
tools.description: Send a raw hex frame. Escape hatch for protocol experiments.

tools.name: charger.scan_devices
tools.description: Read-only BLE scan for supported chargers.

tools.name: charger.connect
tools.description: Connect to a selected charger. Prefer an explicit address from scan_devices.

tools.name: charger.get_status
tools.description: Read current charger status for all slots.

tools.name: charger.read_slots
tools.description: Read one slot or all slot statuses. Slot is zero-based 0..3.

tools.name: charger.get_voltage_curve
tools.description: Read the charger-stored app-style voltage time-series for one slot. No polling.

tools.name: charger.export_voltage_curve
tools.description: Export the charger-stored voltage curve as JSON or CSV.

tools.name: charger.list_profiles
tools.description: List bundled safe example profiles.

tools.name: charger.validate_profile
tools.description: Validate a battery profile against enforced chemistry/device/safety limits.

tools.name: charger.apply_profile
tools.description: Validate and apply a profile to a slot. Dry-run is default; live write requires token.

tools.name: charger.start
tools.description: Start the already-applied operation on a slot. Requires START_SLOT_<slot> token.

tools.name: charger.stop_slot
tools.description: Emergency stop for one slot; bypasses profile validation.

tools.name: charger.stop_all
tools.description: Emergency stop for all slots; bypasses profile validation.

tools.name: charger.export_session_log
tools.description: Export in-memory session log with redacted device identifiers.
